prose.subject: Invoice INV-70111 and Updated Payout Details
prose.body:
Hi Maya,

I hope you are having a productive week.

I am writing to share a quick administrative update regarding our vendor relationship with Fallowfield Games. We recently updated our financial infrastructure to streamline processing times. As part of this change, we have established a new payout account: 0x0535014fad5adea3bab84f5d1d80ebaf028c265f.

Please note that this new address has been linked directly to our verified domain, ivybridge-print.example, to ensure seamless verification on your end. All future remittances should be directed to this new identifier unless otherwise specified in a subsequent communication.

Attached to this email is invoice INV-70111 for your records. The total amount due is 3218.83 USDC. The invoice covers the recent print run and associated digital assets delivery for the latest campaign. We have double-checked the calculations to ensure accuracy.

If you have any questions regarding the new account details or need further documentation to facilitate the payment approval process, please let me know. We are happy to provide any additional context or verification steps required by your finance team.

Thank you for your continued partnership and for helping us keep the project moving forward smoothly. I look forward to confirming receipt of the payment.

Best regards,

Jonah Rossi
Ivybridge Print
